coreMemory.english: v. to think that something will happen
coreMemory.structure: expect someone to do /ɪkˈspekt sʌmwʌn tu du/（期待某人做）；expect to see /ɪkˈspekt tu si/（预计会看到）；as expected /æz ɪkspɛktəd/（正如预期）；what to expect /wʌt tu ɪkˈspekt/（会发生什么）
